app_fee.value: Doctoral (PhD) applications require a $60 USD application fee (many master's programs have no fee).
app_fee.quote: Minimum Required Documents for PhD A completed Catholic University online application along with the $60 application fee.

also.quote: Minimum Required Documents for PhD A completed Catholic University online application along with the $60 application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate Admissions FAQ states many programs do not require a fee and directs applicants to contact cua-gradadmissions@cua.edu; no university-wide PhD fee waiver policy is published on graduate or STEM program admission pages.

gre_general.value: PhD admissions pages state GRE results are required (Biology PhD overrides to Optional; some CEPC programs note GRE may be waived on a case-by-case basis).
gre_general.quote: Minimum Required Documents for PhD ... Results of the Graduate Record Examination are required.

also.quote: GRE scores, for applicants to the doctoral program

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score is 80 for exams taken before Jan 21, 2026 (or 4.5 on the new scale after Jan 21, 2026); IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 120, or PTE 58 also accepted.

also.quote: *For exams taken before January 21, 2026, the Minimum total score: 80 For exams taken after January 21, 2026, the Minimum total score: 4.5

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS score is 6.5 (TOEFL 80/4.5, Duolingo 120, or PTE 58 also accepted).

english_waiver.value: English testing is required for all non-native English speakers; waivers are limited to applicants with a degree (B.A./B.S., graduate degree, or A.A.) from an accredited U.S. institution, not English-medium degrees from India.
english_waiver.quote: The University requires all applicants whose native language is not English to take the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) or an International English Language Testing System (IELTS) exam before they can be considered for final admission. ... The English language testing requirement can be waived on a case-by-case basis should the applicant have appropriate documentation of successful completion of one of the following: ... A graduate degree, a Bachelor's Degree (B.A. or B.S.), or an Associates Degree (A. A.) from an accredited U.S. institution of higher education

notes: TOEFL/GRE institutional code 5104. International general Fall deadline is July 1 (Spring November 1); individual STEM PhD programs set rolling or earlier scholarship priority (Feb 1) deadlines.
